resources.title: Confluent Certification overview
resources.note: Landing page for all Confluent certifications. Its FAQ states 90-minute remotely proctored exams (Honorlock), multiple-choice, matching and list-order items, a 7-day wait before a retake, and rescheduling only 5+ days ahead.

resources.title: CCDAK exam enrollment (training.confluent.io)
resources.note: Where you buy and launch the exam: USD 150, 90 minutes, must be taken within 12 months of purchase and within 48 hours of clicking Start. Your account name must match your government ID.

resources.title: CCDAK exam guide (PDF, April 2025)
resources.note: The official blueprint: domain weights (Fundamentals 23%, App Development 28%, Streams 12%, Connect 15%, Testing 8%, Observability 13%), item types, and an out-of-scope list that includes ksqlDB, RBAC and CFK. No question count or pass mark is given.

resources.title: Confluent Certified Developer Exam Preparation Guide
resources.note: Free e-learning module on exam logistics, fees, discounts and time-management tips. Needs a free training-portal account.

resources.title: Producer configs (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: The source of truth for producer defaults. Note linger.ms now defaults to 5 (changed in 4.0) and acks=all with idempotence on since 3.0.

resources.title: Consumer configs (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: Defaults for session.timeout.ms, max.poll.interval.ms, auto.offset.reset, isolation.level and the rest. Also lists share-consumer configs, which are newer than most study material.

resources.title: Topic configs (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: cleanup.policy, retention.ms, segment.ms, min.insync.replicas, delete.retention.ms and other per-topic settings with defaults.

resources.title: Kafka Streams configs (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: processing.guarantee, num.standby.replicas, state.dir and other Streams settings.

resources.title: Kafka Connect configs (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: Worker, source and sink connector configs, including errors.tolerance and the dead letter queue settings.

resources.title: Kafka design (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: The design chapter: persistence, delivery semantics, replication and ISR, and log compaction. Worth reading end to end once.

resources.title: Transaction protocol (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: How the transaction coordinator, producer epochs and markers work in current Kafka.

resources.title: Consumer rebalance protocol (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: Covers the new group.protocol=consumer (KIP-848) alongside the classic protocol; much older study material only knows the classic one.

resources.title: Upgrade notes (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: Lists the default and behaviour changes per release (KRaft-only 4.0, linger.ms change, removed APIs). Use it to check whether a practice answer is dated.

resources.title: Basic Kafka operations (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: CLI usage for topics, consumer groups and offset resets.

resources.title: Monitoring (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: The JMX metrics for producers, consumers, Streams and Connect, including consumer lag (records-lag-max).

resources.title: Authorization and ACLs (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: ACL model and kafka-acls usage.

resources.title: Authentication using SASL (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: SASL mechanisms and client JAAS configuration.

resources.title: Streams core concepts (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: Stream-table duality, time semantics, state and processing guarantees.

resources.title: Streams DSL (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: Operator reference including the join and windowing tables (which joins need co-partitioning, grace periods).

resources.title: Testing a Streams application (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: TopologyTestDriver, TestInputTopic and TestOutputTopic usage.

resources.title: Kafka Connect user guide (Kafka 4.4)
resources.note: Standalone vs distributed workers, the REST API, transforms and exactly-once source support.

resources.title: Schema evolution and compatibility (Confluent)
resources.note: The compatibility-type table: which changes each mode allows and whether to upgrade consumers or producers first.

resources.title: Formats, serializers and deserializers (Confluent)
resources.note: Wire format (magic byte plus 4-byte schema ID) and subject name strategies.

resources.title: Kafka Connect for Confluent Platform
resources.note: Confluent's Connect overview: workers, connectors, tasks and converters.

resources.title: Kafka Streams basics (Confluent)
resources.note: Confluent's concepts page for Streams; good companion to the Apache pages.

resources.title: Message delivery guarantees (Confluent)
resources.note: Short explanation of at-most-once, at-least-once and exactly-once in Kafka terms.

resources.title: ksqlDB for Confluent Platform
resources.note: Official ksqlDB overview. Out of scope: the April 2025 exam guide excludes Confluent components (RBAC, ksqlDB, CFK).

resources.title: Confluent REST Proxy
resources.note: Out of scope for the CCDAK: the exam guide lists Confluent components such as ksqlDB as out of scope. What REST Proxy does and its API versions.

resources.title: Confluent Control Center
resources.note: Out of scope for the CCDAK: the exam guide lists Confluent components such as ksqlDB as out of scope. Control Center docs (moved out of the Platform tree). Only for background; not in the current blueprint.

resources.title: Apache Kafka 101
resources.note: Free Confluent course; listed in the exam guide's learning path. Start here.

resources.title: Apache Kafka Internal Architecture
resources.note: Free deep dive on brokers, replication, compaction and the consumer group protocol.

resources.title: Kafka transactions (Internal Architecture module)
resources.note: How transactions give exactly-once semantics, with a hands-on module after it.

resources.title: Kafka Streams 101
resources.note: Free course named in the exam guide; covers KTable, joins, windowing, time and testing.

resources.title: Kafka Connect 101
resources.note: Free course named in the exam guide; includes error handling and dead letter queues.

resources.title: Schema Registry 101
resources.note: Free course on subjects, formats and compatibility.

resources.title: Designing Events and Event Streams
resources.note: Recommended in the exam guide for data-modelling questions.

resources.title: Apache Kafka Security
resources.note: Free course on SSL, SASL, ACLs and encryption. One module covers ZooKeeper, which is legacy in Kafka 4.x.

resources.title: Kafka: The Definitive Guide (free from Confluent)
resources.note: Free download after a form. The page text still names the first-edition authors, so confirm you get the 2nd edition (2021). Even the 2nd edition predates the 3.0 and 4.0 default changes.

resources.title: OpenExamPrep: Confluent Kafka Developer practice questions
resources.note: Free, no-signup question bank (200+). It says its items are original, not recalled exam items. Check every answer against the 4.4 docs.

resources.title: Confluent Community: CCDAK Preparation Tips
resources.note: 2024 thread asking for resources beyond Confluent's own. The only reply points to GitHub study repos; not much detail.

resources.title: Confluent Community: Training required for success exam
resources.note: 2021 thread with prep advice: the Confluent developer course, the free Fundamentals accreditation and hands-on experience.

resources.title: Radu Pana: CCDAK Study Guide (Hashnode, 2025)
resources.note: Long study guide from someone who passed in July 2025. Conflicts with the docs: it calls acks=1 the common default and linger.ms=0 the default (4.x: acks=all, linger.ms=5).

resources.title: danielsobrado/CCDAK-Exam-Questions
resources.note: Large set of AI-assisted practice questions and notes. Licence CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, so don't copy. Its producer notes give pre-3.0 defaults (acks=1, enable.idempotence=false, linger.ms=0).

resources.title: vaquarkhan/CCDAK-Exam-Practice-Test-2
resources.note: No licence file; last updated 2020. The description matches a paid Udemy course, so treat it as dated and don't copy. Covers ZooKeeper and KSQL, which no longer apply.

resources.title: Exactly-once Semantics is Possible (Confluent)
resources.note: Neha Narkhede's original EOS post. The concepts hold up, but the configs date from 0.11.

resources.title: Transactions in Apache Kafka (Confluent)
resources.note: Classic explanation of the transaction coordinator, markers and read_committed.

resources.title: Hands-Free Kafka Replication (Confluent)
resources.note: Explains how ISR membership is decided by replica.lag.time.max.ms.

resources.title: How to choose the number of topics/partitions (Confluent)
resources.note: Jun Rao's partition-count guidance. Some limits are ZooKeeper-era; KRaft raises them.

resources.title: Sticky partitioner (Confluent)
resources.note: Why keyless records stick to one partition per batch (KIP-480) instead of round-robin.

resources.title: Apache Kafka message compression (Confluent)
resources.note: Producer vs broker compression.type and the codec trade-offs.

resources.title: Multi-threaded messaging with the Kafka consumer (Confluent)
resources.note: Poll loop, max.poll.interval.ms and safe offset commits with worker threads.

resources.title: KIP-848: new consumer rebalance protocol (Confluent)
resources.note: The broker-driven rebalance protocol that became GA in Kafka 4.0.

resources.title: Apache Kafka 4.0 release (Confluent)
resources.note: Summary of 4.0: KRaft only, KIP-848, queues. Useful for spotting outdated study material.

resources.title: Crossing the Streams: Joins in Apache Kafka (Confluent)
resources.note: Worked examples of every join type. Written before grace periods became mandatory in the windowing APIs.

resources.title: Kafka Streams' take on watermarks and triggers (Confluent)
resources.note: Grace periods and suppress() for final window results.

resources.title: Tuning RocksDB for Kafka Streams state stores (Confluent)
resources.note: How state stores use RocksDB; deeper than the exam needs.

resources.title: Kafka Connect deep dive: converters and serialization (Confluent)
resources.note: Robin Moffatt on converters, schemas.enable and common errors.

resources.title: Kafka Connect deep dive: error handling and DLQs (Confluent)
resources.note: errors.tolerance and dead letter queue configs with examples.

resources.title: Common mistakes configuring multiple Connect workers (rmoff)
resources.note: Robin Moffatt on group.id and the internal storage topics in distributed mode.

resources.title: Should you put several event types in one topic? (Confluent)
resources.note: Martin Kleppmann on subject name strategies and topic design.

resources.title: Yes, Virginia, you really do need a Schema Registry (Confluent)
resources.note: Why schemas and compatibility checks matter.

resources.title: Why Avro for Kafka data? (Confluent)
resources.note: Jay Kreps' case for Avro with Kafka.

resources.title: Apache Kafka Security 101 (Confluent)
resources.note: Overview of TLS, SASL and ACLs. Older examples use ZooKeeper-based tooling.

resources.title: Kafka listeners explained (Confluent)
resources.note: Robin Moffatt on listeners and advertised.listeners, a common cause of client connection failures.

resources.title: Error handling patterns in Kafka (Confluent)
resources.note: Retryable vs non-retryable errors and DLQ patterns, which the exam guide lists explicitly.

resources.title: Kafka acks explained (Conduktor)
resources.note: Clear diagrams of acks=0/1/all with min.insync.replicas.

resources.title: Kafka storage internals: segments, rolling and retention (Strimzi)
resources.note: Hands-on look at how retention deletes whole segments, never the active one.

resources.title: Testing Kafka Streams code (Confluent docs)
resources.note: TopologyTestDriver and mock clients from Confluent's docs.

resources.title: My experience getting CCDAK (dev.to, 2021)
resources.note: First-hand 2021 report: proctored online, 90 minutes, some very specific config questions. Older exam version, so question count and format may differ.

examReports.theme: Exact config behaviour, not just concepts
examReports.detail: Candidates say some questions turn on precise settings and defaults, so learn the config reference pages, not just the ideas.
People who passed and forum regulars both say real use of producers, consumers and the CLI helps more than reading alone.
Candidates find many paid and free question banks out of date after Kafka's recent changes. Check every answer against current docs.

examReports.theme: No published question count or pass mark
examReports.detail: Confluent publishes 90 minutes and the domain weights but no question count or pass mark. Third-party numbers (60 questions, ~70-75%) are guesses.

examReports.theme: Streams and Connect get real weight
examReports.detail: Prep write-ups put serious time on Streams (KTable, joins, windows, state) and Connect (converters, errors), in line with the 12% and 15% blueprint weights.
